bear.assumptions: Execution slips, receivables stay ~130 days, FY27 guidance missed, derating to 18x

base.assumptions: FY27 rev +~20% (below 25% guide), ~9% PAT margin, Changodar ramps from Q3 FY27, ~30cr shares

bull.assumptions: Guidance met, 10% PAT margin, order book converts, enquiry pipeline Rs23,000cr wins

extreme_bull.assumptions: Grid capex supercycle plus export share gains

result.hard_numeric_fact_text: Two 2 Oct 2026 order intimations (GETCO) ~Rs1,000cr (dossier, ~26% of annual revenue); unexecuted order book Rs6,630cr at 30 Jun 2026 vs FY26 revenue Rs2,395cr (~2.8x) (search-reported)

risk.cycle: MEDIUM: grid/transformer capex cycle strong but stock -43% in 12m
risk.order_firmness: MEDIUM: firm state-utility POs (GETCO, PGCIL) but tendered, receivable-heavy

result.thesis: Record order book (Rs6,630cr, ~2.8x FY26 revenue) and Changodar expansion with utilisation normalising from Q3 FY27 give a credible grid-capex story, but reported Q1 FY27 revenue +8%, flat EBITDA, PAT down, CFO/PAT -0.40 and receivable days 132 show no earnings inflection yet. EV is modest with a deep bear case.
result.demand_signal: Grid transformer orders: GETCO ~Rs1,000cr, PGCIL Rs1,000cr+; Q1 inflow Rs2,114cr (+218%) (search-reported)
result.pricing_signal: EBITDA margin 16.3% dossier (-0.3pt); no pricing evidence
result.order_book: Rs6,630cr at 30 Jun 2026, +26% YoY; enquiry pipeline ~Rs23,000cr (search-reported, management)
result.capacity_catalyst: Changodar expansion due ~Aug 2026; utilisation normalising Q3 FY27 (management claim)
kill_conditions: FY27 revenue growth guidance cut below 15%
Receivable days rise above 150 or CFO/PAT negative again in H1 FY27
Q2 FY27 revenue not above Rs700cr
catalysts: Q2 FY27 results and call (date in 6 Oct intimation)
result.biggest_risk: Order book fails to convert to cash: receivables +89% vs revenue +24%, negative CFO.
result.next_datapoint: Q2 FY27 results: revenue vs Rs700cr, Changodar utilisation, CFO and receivable days
